content.json:
# BTP Overview Dashboard

This dashboard provides a birds-eye view of audit log activity across BTP accounts. This is intended to show the most active accounts and event sources, and general trends in activity.

Modify the Time Range selector to alter the lookback period and select the Identity Management tab to see more. The vulnerability posture KPI below requires the separate SAP BTP AVL connector — see the **Application Vulnerabilities** tab for full details.

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on UpdatedOn from {TimeRange:start} to now() step 1d by Tenant
| project-away UpdatedOn
| join kind = inner (SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
    | summarize Requests = count() by Tenant
    ) on Tenant
| project Tenant, Requests, Trend
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Most active accounts by events generated
Ingested events by audit category

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where Category == "audit.security-events"
| where Message has "UserAuthenticationSuccess"
| make-series Events = count() default = 0 on UpdatedOn from {TimeRange:start} to now() step 1d by Tenant
content.title: Successful user sign-in activity over time

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where Category == "audit.security-events"
| where Message has "Unauthorized access attempt"
| make-series Events = count() default = 0 on UpdatedOn from {TimeRange:start} to now() step 1d by Tenant
| extend (baseline) = series_decompose(Events)
| extend (anomalies, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(Events, 3, -1, 'linefit')
content.title: Business Application Studio sign-in: unauthorized access anomalies

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where Entities has "SAP BTP"
| make-series Events = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to now() step 1d
content.title: BTP Security alerts over time

| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}

| summarize Value = count()

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where UpdatedOn >= {TimeRange:start}
| where Message has "scim user"
| extend Action = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Message.object)).id)).crudType)
| summarize Events = count() by UserName, Action

content.query:

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where UpdatedOn between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where Message has "scim user"
| extend Action = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Message.object)).id)).crudType)
| summarize Events = count() by UserName, Action
| evaluate pivot(Action, sum(Events)) : (UserName:string, CREATE:int, UPDATE:int, DELETE:int)
| extend Events = CREATE + UPDATE + DELETE
| order by Events asc
content.title: Most rare user account management events by user

content.query:
let user_account_changes = materialize(SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
    | where UpdatedOn between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where isnotempty(Message.object)
    | where Message has "scim user"
    | extend Attributes = parse_json(Message.attributes)
    | mv-expand Attributes
    | where isnotempty(Attributes.new)
    | extend New = replace_regex(tostring(Attributes.new), "\\r", "")
    | extend Old = replace_regex(tostring(Attributes.old), "\\r", "")
    | extend Action = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Message.object)).id)).crudType)
    | project UpdatedOn, UserName, Action, Tenant, New, Old);
let old_user = user_account_changes
    | project-away New
    | project-rename Column = Old
    | extend Value = "Old"
    | where not (Action == "CREATE" and Value == "Old");
let new_user = user_account_changes
    | project-away Old
    | project-rename Column = New
    | extend Value = "New";
union old_user, new_user
| extend Column = parse_json(Column)
| evaluate bag_unpack(Column): (
    UpdatedOn: datetime
    , UserName: string
    , Tenant: string
    , Action: string
    , Value: string
    , userName: string
    , active: string
    , emails: string
    , externalId: string
    , id: string
    , meta: string
    , name: string
    , origin: string
    , passwordLastModified: datetime
    , verified: string
    , zoneid: string)
| where UserName !startswith "sb-"
| order by UpdatedOn desc, Value asc
content.title: User account management activity

content.query:
SAPBTPAuditLog_CL
| where UpdatedOn between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where Message has_any ("xs_rolecollection2user", "xsrolecollection2role", "xsrolecollections")
| where UserName != "client/hcp_onboarding"
| extend ChangeId = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(Message.object).id))
| evaluate bag_unpack(ChangeId)
| project-away TimeGenerated, Message, MessageUuid, OrgId, SpaceId, AlsServiceId, Category
| project-reorder UpdatedOn, UserName
content.title: Security role collection management events

content.json:
# BTP Audit Coverage

This view identifies custom BTP applications that have user logins but no business audit trail. These applications may be missing audit log service bindings or `@AuditLog` annotations, creating security blind spots where user actions are invisible to monitoring.

content.query:
let platform_service_patterns = dynamic([
    "app-studio", "auditlog", "cis-local", "service-manager",
    "destination-xsappname", "connectivity-proxy", "feature-flags"
]);
let base = materialize(SAPBTPAuditLog_CL | where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start});
let app_logins = base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events"
    | extend data_s = tostring(Message.data)
    | where data_s has "TokenIssuedEvent"
    | extend ParsedData = parse_json(data_s)
    | extend ClientId = tostring(ParsedData.origin)
    | where ClientId startswith "sb-"
    | extend EventMessage = tostring(ParsedData.message)
    | extend GrantType = extract(@'"grant_type"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, EventMessage)
    | where GrantType == "authorization_code"
    | extend XsAppName = extract(@"^sb-(.+?)!\w+$", 1, ClientId)
    | where isnotempty(XsAppName)
    | where not(XsAppName has_any (platform_service_patterns))
    | extend AppName = extract(@"^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)", 1, XsAppName)
    | extend HumanUser = extract(@'"user_name"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, EventMessage);
let audited_by_sb = base
    | where Category !in ("audit.security-events")
    | where UserName startswith "sb-"
    | extend AuditedAppName = extract(@"^sb-(.+?)!\w+", 1, UserName)
    | where isnotempty(AuditedAppName)
    | distinct AuditedAppName, Tenant;
let audited_by_binding = base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events"
    | where UserName contains "customer-auditlog"
    | where isnotempty(AlsServiceId)
    | distinct AlsServiceId, Tenant;
let all_apps_summary = app_logins
    | summarize
        LoginCount = count(),
        FirstLogin = min(TimeGenerated),
        LastLogin = max(TimeGenerated),
        Users = make_set(HumanUser, 100)
        by AppName, XsAppName, AlsServiceId, SubaccountName, Tenant;
let audited_xsappnames = union
    (audited_by_sb | project XsAppName = AuditedAppName, Tenant),
    (audited_by_binding
        | join kind=inner (all_apps_summary | distinct XsAppName, AlsServiceId, Tenant) on AlsServiceId, Tenant
        | project XsAppName, Tenant)
    | distinct XsAppName, Tenant;
all_apps_summary
| join kind=leftouter (audited_xsappnames | extend IsAudited = true) on XsAppName, Tenant
| extend AuditStatus = iff(IsAudited == true, "Audited", "Unaudited")
| project AppName, XsAppName, SubaccountName, Tenant, AuditStatus, LoginCount, FirstLogin, LastLogin, Users
| order by AuditStatus asc, LoginCount desc
content.title: Custom app audit coverage

let platform_service_patterns = dynamic([
    "app-studio", "auditlog", "cis-local", "service-manager",
    "destination-xsappname", "connectivity-proxy", "feature-flags"
]);

let app_logins = base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events"
    | extend data_s = tostring(Message.data)
    | where data_s has "TokenIssuedEvent"
    | extend ParsedData = parse_json(data_s)
    | extend ClientId = tostring(ParsedData.origin)
    | where ClientId startswith "sb-"
    | extend EventMessage = tostring(ParsedData.message)
    | extend GrantType = extract(@'"grant_type"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', 1, EventMessage)
    | where GrantType == "authorization_code"
    | extend XsAppName = extract(@"^sb-(.+?)!\w+$", 1, ClientId)
    | where isnotempty(XsAppName)
    | where not(XsAppName has_any (platform_service_patterns))
    | distinct XsAppName, AlsServiceId, Tenant;
let audited_by_sb = base
    | where Category !in ("audit.security-events")
    | where UserName startswith "sb-"
    | extend AuditedAppName = extract(@"^sb-(.+?)!\w+", 1, UserName)
    | where isnotempty(AuditedAppName)
    | distinct AuditedAppName, Tenant;
let audited_by_binding = base
    | where Category == "audit.security-events"
    | where UserName contains "customer-auditlog"
    | where isnotempty(AlsServiceId)
    | distinct AlsServiceId, Tenant;
let audited_xsappnames = union
    (audited_by_sb | project XsAppName = AuditedAppName, Tenant),
    (audited_by_binding
        | join kind=inner (app_logins) on AlsServiceId, Tenant
        | project XsAppName, Tenant)
    | distinct XsAppName, Tenant;
let total_apps = app_logins | summarize Total = dcount(XsAppName);
let audited_count = audited_xsappnames
| join kind=inner (app_logins | distinct XsAppName, Tenant) on XsAppName, Tenant
| summarize Audited = dcount(XsAppName);
total_apps
| extend placeholder = 1
| join kind=leftouter (audited_count | extend placeholder = 1) on placeholder
| extend Audited = coalesce(Audited, 0)
| extend Unaudited = Total - Audited
| extend AuditedPct = iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Audited / Total, 1))
| project Score = iff(Total == 0, "No custom app logins in range", strcat(Audited, " / ", Total, " apps audited (", AuditedPct, "%)")), AuditedPct
content.title: Audit coverage score

content.json:
# Application Vulnerabilities

> **Requires the SAP BTP Application Vulnerability (AVL) connector** — this tab visualizes findings from the `SAPBTPAVL_CL` table, populated by the separate SAP Application Vulnerability Report Service connector (`SAPBTPAVL`). If only the SAP BTP audit log connector is connected, this tab will show no data until the AVL connector is also deployed.

This view surfaces vulnerability findings (vulnerable open-source packages, high CVSS CVEs) in custom applications deployed on SAP BTP, so risky apps can be prioritized for remediation.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize Value = count()
content.title: Open findings
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.title: Critical findings (CVSS ≥ threshold)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize Value = dcount(AppId)
content.title: Vulnerable apps
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize LastIngested = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend MinutesSinceLastIngest = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastIngested)
| project MinutesSinceLastIngest
content.title: Minutes since last ingest
content.noDataMessage: No AVL data ingested in the last 30 days. Confirm the SAP BTP AVL connector (SAPBTPAVL) is connected and ingesting into SAPBTPAVL_CL.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize Findings = count() by Severity
| order by Findings desc
content.title: Findings by severity
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| extend AgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), FirstFound)
| extend AgeBucket = case(
    AgeDays <= 7, "0-7 days",
    AgeDays <= 30, "8-30 days",
    AgeDays <= 90, "31-90 days",
    "90+ days")
| summarize Findings = count() by AgeBucket
| extend SortOrder = case(
    AgeBucket == "0-7 days", 1,
    AgeBucket == "8-30 days", 2,
    AgeBucket == "31-90 days", 3,
    4)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder
content.title: Remediation backlog (age since first found)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize NewFindings = count() by bin(FirstFound, 1d), Severity
| order by FirstFound asc
content.title: New findings over time by severity (first found date)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range.

content.query:
let critical_threshold = todouble('{CvssThreshold}');
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| summarize
    Findings = count(),
    CriticalFindings = countif(MaxCvss >= critical_threshold),
    HighestCvss = max(MaxCvss)
    by AppName, SubaccountName
| top 10 by Findings desc
content.title: Top 10 vulnerable applications (by open finding count)
content.noDataMessage: No AVL findings in this time range.

content.query:
SAPBTPAVL_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FindingId
| project
    FindingId,
    AppName,
    SubaccountName,
    Severity,
    MaxCvss,
    ActiveCves,
    PackageNames,
    Recommendation,
    VulnerabilityUrl,
    FirstFound,
    LastFound
| order by MaxCvss desc, LastFound desc
content.title: Findings detail
